pages.title: Walkthrough:Getting Started
pages.summary_en: Character creation, controls, objectives, recovery, and saving.
pages.summary_zh: 从角色创建到第一次存档，认清界面、找到目标、安排好时间与恢复。

pages.title: Game Systems:Blacksmith and Forge
pages.summary_en: Find Gastoff, upgrade your equipment, forge five tiers of armor pieces, and plan construction costs.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Gastoff，升级基础装备，打造五级护具，并查清建筑委托的条件与费用。

pages.title: Game Systems:Mining System
pages.summary_en: Choose your tools, turn fragments into whole resources, and plan for Soul Stones, enhancement ore and Chronium.
pages.summary_zh: 选好镐、看懂碎片与完整资源，再规划灵魂石、强化矿和时源矿的开采。

pages.title: Character:Chime
pages.summary_en: Find the Crystal Cavern, follow Chime’s relationship route, and check Resistance Clout requirements.
pages.summary_zh: 找到水晶洞窟，按顺序推进 Chime 的个人路线，查清反抗军声望与关系要求。

pages.title: Character:Daphne
pages.summary_en: Recruit Daphne, prepare her room, and unlock her personal visits and shared corridor events.
pages.summary_zh: 为 Daphne 准备住处，完成招募，再逐步开放个人拜访与走廊共同事件。

pages.title: Character:Kyou
pages.summary_en: Meet Kyou in the Fringe park, follow her timed events, and unlock Heart-to-Hearts and optional dates.
pages.summary_zh: 在边缘区公园认识 Kyou，按时段推进个人事件，并开放谈心与可选约会。

pages.title: Game Systems:Body Modifications
pages.summary_en: Find Tinker’s two workshops, compare all eight modifications, and budget each permanent upgrade.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Tinker 的两处工坊，比较八条永久改造路线，查清等级上限、奖励与安装费用。

pages.title: Game Systems:Soul Stones
pages.summary_en: Find all eight stones, understand their passive effects, and choose between bonding, mining enhancements and material upgrades.
pages.summary_zh: 收集八种灵魂石，了解持有即生效的加成，再选择羁绊、采矿强化或材料升级。

pages.title: Character:Mittens
pages.summary_en: Complete the rescue, open Mittens’ room, and follow her guestbook chapters, dreams and Heart-to-Hearts.
pages.summary_zh: 完成营救，为 Mittens 开放房间，再按顺序体验留言簿章节、梦中冒险与谈心。

pages.title: Character:Tinsel
pages.summary_en: Find Tinsel through the Christmas encounter chain, unlock her tavern, and plan repeat visits and gifts.
pages.summary_zh: 沿圣诞遭遇线找到 Tinsel，开放她的酒馆，查清日常拜访与赠礼要求。

pages.title: Character:Vardis
pages.summary_en: Find Vardis at the Deep Woods landmarks and plan the walking route, travel costs and information visits.
pages.summary_zh: 在深林入口与地标找到 Vardis，查阅行走路线、出行消耗和可询问的信息。

pages.title: Game Systems:Combat System
pages.summary_en: Prepare for ordinary combat, choose skills, react to incoming attacks, and understand defenses, status effects and recovery.
pages.summary_zh: 做好开战准备，选用合适招式，掌握限时格挡，并看懂防御、异常状态与恢复。

pages.title: Game Systems:Specialist Class
pages.summary_en: Unlock Blademaster, Assassin and Sorcerer, earn points with the right actions, and understand independent ranks and bonuses.
pages.summary_zh: 解锁剑术大师、刺客与术士，用对应招式积累点数，了解独立阶级与成长加成。

pages.title: Character:Gem
pages.summary_en: Find Gem, restock mining tools, learn dungeon-wall Mining, and follow her recruitment and personal routes.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Gem，补充采矿工具、学习地下城破墙技能，并推进招募与个人路线。

pages.title: Character:Gastoff
pages.summary_en: Meet Gastoff, check his personal bonuses, and find the equipment and construction services you need.
pages.summary_zh: 拜访 Gastoff，查看一次性属性奖励，并找到需要的装备与建筑服务。

pages.title: Character:Tinker
pages.summary_en: Follow Tinker’s events, conversations and dates, and check when her lab and Fortress services are available.
pages.summary_zh: 按顺序推进 Tinker 的事件、谈心与约会，并查清实验室和要塞服务的开放时间。

pages.title: Character:Theneas
pages.summary_en: Reach the secluded Forest Hut, meet Theneas, and check access to his Soul Stone refinements.
pages.summary_zh: 沿幽僻小径抵达森林小屋，认识 Theneas，并查清灵魂石升级服务的条件。

pages.title: Character:Councilor Voss
pages.summary_en: Find Councilor Voss’s office and understand his dialogue and connection to current mission objectives.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Councilor Voss 的办公室，了解拜访方式与相关任务的推进方向。

pages.title: Character:Officer Becky
pages.summary_en: Follow Becky’s investigation, find the correct locations and time windows, and plan conversations and outings.
pages.summary_zh: 沿 Officer Becky 的调查线继续，找准地点与时段，安排谈心和外出。

pages.title: Game Systems:Ruxandra's Alchemy Shop
pages.summary_en: Reach Blood Alchemy, decide how to use Blood Orbs, and compare six artifacts and two repeatable refinements.
pages.summary_zh: 找到血液炼金商店，规划鲜血宝珠的用途，比较六件永久物品与两项可重复强化。

pages.title: Game Systems:Relationships Dating and Intimacy
pages.summary_en: Build affection, follow personal routes, use relationship cards, and distinguish dates, commitment and character-specific experience.
pages.summary_zh: 提升好感、推进个人路线、看懂关系卡，并分清约会、交往承诺与角色专属经验。

pages.title: Game Systems:Pregnancy
pages.summary_en: Set your preference, complete the shared protocol, check each character’s readiness, and understand pregnancy timing and activity changes.
pages.summary_zh: 设置偏好、完成共用规程、检查角色准备条件，并了解怀孕期间的时间推进与行动变化。

pages.title: Character:Aaliyah
pages.summary_en: Find Aaliyah at the KTV entrance and check the venue’s late-night hours.
pages.summary_zh: 在 KTV 入口找到 Aaliyah，查清深夜营业时段与当前可用互动。

pages.title: Character:Andi
pages.summary_en: Follow Andi’s personal route, plan dates and Private Time, and check her one-time gift.
pages.summary_zh: 推进 Andi 的个人路线，安排约会与独处，并查看一次性礼物的条件。

pages.title: Character:Saline
pages.summary_en: Follow Saline’s complete recruitment route, including conversations, dates and the move to the Medical Bay.
pages.summary_zh: 按顺序完成 Saline 的招募路线，核对谈心、约会，以及搬入医疗室后的拜访方式。

pages.title: Character:Sophie
pages.summary_en: Find Sophie, follow her safe introduction and work route, and plan personal visits and gifts.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Sophie，按顺序推进初遇与工作路线，安排个人拜访和赠礼。

pages.title: Character:Pixie
pages.summary_en: Find Pixie’s early encounters, check recruitment requirements, and plan daily interactions.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Pixie 的前期遭遇，查清招募条件与日常互动的安排。

pages.title: Character:The Blessed Ones
pages.summary_en: Find the Blessed Ones at the Anomaly Temple and understand their current role in exploration.
pages.summary_zh: 在异常神殿找到 The Blessed Ones，了解拜访方式与当前可用内容。

pages.title: Game Systems:Dungeon
pages.summary_en: Plan ordinary dungeon exploration: movement, floor themes, supplies, hidden routes, recruitment and Dragon Coins.
pages.summary_zh: 规划普通地下城探索：看懂移动与楼层主题，备齐补给，查找密道、招募路线与龙币用途。

pages.title: Game Systems:Infinity Dungeons
pages.summary_en: Unlock a separate endless dungeon, understand its progress and enemy traits, and plan the materials you want to earn.
pages.summary_zh: 解锁独立的无尽探索，分清深度、敌人特性与材料奖励，再按目标安排挑战。

pages.title: Game Systems:Story Beats
pages.summary_en: Find the next main-story location and time, check manual actions and prerequisites, and reveal later steps only when needed.
pages.summary_zh: 查找下一段主线的地点、时段与前置条件；后期步骤按需展开，避免提前看到剧情。

pages.title: Game Systems:Chaos Syndicate
pages.summary_en: Navigate the Syndicate, follow its shared missions and alliance, and keep optional personal routes separate.
pages.summary_zh: 找到辛迪加内部地点，依次推进共同任务与联盟支线，再按需查看个人路线。

pages.title: Game Systems:Alignment System
pages.summary_en: Read the lead between your alignment counters, plan daily gains, and compare relationship, combat and reset effects.
pages.summary_zh: 看懂三项点数的领先差值，安排每日行动，查清关系收益、战斗效果与重置费用。

pages.title: Game Systems:Bar Games
pages.summary_en: Find Vera’s four games, learn their controls, and distinguish winnings from the money returned with your stake.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Vera 的四种小游戏，学会操作与结算规则，分清本金、底池和真正计入进度的净盈利。

pages.title: Game Systems:Fishing
pages.summary_en: Prepare your rod and bait, steer into fishing rings, learn the reel timing, and compare catches and permanent boat upgrades.
pages.summary_zh: 备好钓竿与鱼饵，驾驶小船进入水圈、掌握收线时机，再查找渔获、收益和永久船只升级。

pages.title: Game Systems:Caterpillar Rearing
pages.summary_en: Collect and release native species, research five paths, and grow a lasting ecosystem across two eras.
pages.summary_zh: 收集并放归原生物种，研究五条方向，让现代与中世纪的生态随游戏日逐步成长。

pages.title: Game Systems:Haunted Mansion
pages.summary_en: Explore both mansion chapters, distinguish revealing from collecting souls, and check puzzle controls, passage requirements and optional rewards.
pages.summary_zh: 探索豪宅两篇内容，分清揭示与收集灵魂的步骤，按需查找谜题操作、通道条件和可选奖励。

pages.title: Character:Ghost
pages.summary_en: Find Ghost, follow her conversations and main-story requirements, and plan training and personal visits.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Ghost，核对谈心与主线前置，安排训练和个人拜访。

pages.title: Character:Saber
pages.summary_en: Follow Saber’s late-story personal route, check her move to the Barracks, and plan dates and shared visits with Kitty.
pages.summary_zh: 推进 Saber 的后期个人路线，查清兵营中的拜访方式，以及约会和与 Kitty 共同事件的条件。

pages.title: Character:Kitty
pages.summary_en: Meet Kitty at the Syndicate Big Top, unlock repeatable conversations and Rogue training, and follow her personal route.
pages.summary_zh: 在辛迪加大帐篷认识 Kitty，开放日常交谈与盗贼训练，再按顺序推进个人路线。

pages.title: Character:Arestes
pages.summary_en: Reach Arestes’s Hidden Chamber, join the Thieves Guild, and distinguish personal events from guild services.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Arestes 所在的隐藏密室，加入盗贼公会，并分清个人事件与公会服务的条件。

pages.title: Character:Keira
pages.summary_en: Find Keira’s rooftop race, understand its chance to win, and follow her conversations, date and special commission.
pages.summary_zh: 找到 Keira 的屋顶竞速，了解获胜条件，再推进谈心、约会与特殊委托。

pages.title: Character:Shadow
pages.summary_en: Find Shadow’s changing nightly locations, follow the guild and recruitment routes, and plan her movement skills and visits.
pages.summary_zh: 看懂 Shadow 的夜间行踪，推进公会与招募路线，查找移动技能和个人拜访的条件。

pages.title: Game Systems:Brothel
pages.title_zh: 玫瑰与荆棘：青楼与酒店
pages.summary_en: Manage workers, bedrooms and apprentices, plan permanent improvements, and find the right room for each service.
pages.summary_zh: 管理员工、卧室和学徒，安排永久升级，并找到训练、医疗、招募与日常经营所需的房间。
search_terms: 玫瑰与荆棘：青楼与酒店

pages.title: Game Systems:Brothel Stats and Calculations
pages.summary_en: Read the daily report, understand worker passives and pay, and trace EXP, Stress, reputation, tax, upkeep and cleaning.
pages.summary_zh: 看懂每日营业报告，查清固有被动、工资、经验、压力与声誉，以及税、维护费和清洁的结算方式。

pages.title: Game Systems:Investment System
pages.summary_en: Compare all fifty businesses, plan five investment levels and the separate buyout, and collect earnings with the right timing.
pages.summary_zh: 比较五十家企业，分清五级投资与另行买断的费用，并查清每日收益、风险和收取时机。

pages.title: Game Systems:Sirena Isle Resort
pages.summary_en: Reach the island, manage three vacation slots, find current activities, and spend Sea Shells on the right permanent rewards.
pages.summary_zh: 前往塞壬岛，管理三个休假名额，查找当前活动，并按目标使用海贝壳购买永久奖励。

pages.title: Game Systems:Fighters Guild
pages.summary_en: Prepare for contracts, follow all twenty-six jobs, learn combat skills and understand what advances guild progress.
pages.summary_zh: 为契约任务做好准备，按顺序完成二十六项工作，查找战斗课程，并分清哪些战斗计入公会进度。

pages.title: Game Systems:Thieves Guild
pages.summary_en: Find the night entrance and Hidden Chamber, join the guild, plan heists and compare the three-day item commissions.
pages.summary_zh: 找到夜间入口与隐藏密室，推进入会和晋升，安排住宅窃盗，并比较耗时三天的物品委托。

pages.title: Game Systems:Wizard Faction
pages.summary_en: Find the teachers, count Wizard Clout correctly, and prepare lessons, errands and the initiation test.
pages.summary_zh: 找到各位老师，正确计算巫师声望，并查清课程、跑腿任务与入会考验的前置条件。

pages.title: Game Systems:Bards Guild
pages.summary_en: Learn to compose and perform, track unique songs and venues, and follow the current guild and Lily requirements.
pages.summary_zh: 学习创作与演出，分清不同歌曲和场地的记录，并核对公会与 Lily 路线的当前要求。

pages.title: Character:Aimy
pages.summary_en: Follow AIMy’s control-room conversations, late story requirements, dates and technical lesson.
pages.summary_zh: 按顺序推进AIMy的控制室谈心、后期主线条件、约会与技术课程。

pages.title: Character:Akira
pages.summary_en: Find Akira’s examination schedule, research follow-ups, dates and pregnancy consultations.
pages.summary_zh: 查清Akira的检查回访时间、研究进展、约会与生育咨询。

pages.title: Character:Anthrax
pages.summary_en: Find Anthrax’s recruitment steps, Training Hall hours, combat lessons and army services.
pages.summary_zh: 了解Anthrax的招募步骤、训练厅时段、战斗课程与军队服务。

pages.title: Character:Nova
pages.summary_en: Follow Nova’s research route, required dates and H2Hs, then unlock her private activities.
pages.summary_zh: 按顺序完成Nova的研究事件、必需约会与谈心，开放后续私人活动。

pages.title: Character:Glitch
pages.summary_en: Reach Glitch’s Den and follow her lessons, personal route, recruitment and private activities.
pages.summary_zh: 找到Glitch的藏身处，推进技能课程、个人路线、军队招募与私人活动。

pages.title: Character:Cressida
pages.summary_en: Track Cressida’s alternating workplaces, personal scenes, lessons and relationship requirements.
pages.summary_zh: 掌握Cressida的单双日工作地点、个人事件、技能课程与关系条件。

pages.title: Character:Neena
pages.summary_en: Find Neena’s current schedule and the dates, H2Hs and story steps needed for recruitment.
pages.summary_zh: 查清Neena的出没安排，以及招募所需的约会、谈心与个人事件。

pages.title: Character:Riki
pages.summary_en: Recruit Riki, follow her location-based personal route and unlock training, dates and private time.
pages.summary_zh: 招募Riki，按地点推进个人路线，开放训练、约会与私人相处。

pages.title: Game Systems:New Game+ and Postgame
pages.summary_en: Check New Game+ eligibility, prepare your save, and see exactly which progress carries over or restarts.
pages.summary_zh: 查清新游戏+的开启条件、存档准备，以及属性、装备、关系和经营进度的保留与重置规则。

pages.title: Game Systems:Crystals and Doomsday
pages.summary_en: Plan Crystal spending, extend the timeline, compare both shops, and find reliable one-time and repeatable rewards.
pages.summary_zh: 安排水晶开销，延长时间线，比较两处商店，并分清一次性奖励与可重复的获取方式。

pages.title: Game Systems:Objectives, Tutorials and Trophy Goals
pages.summary_en: Track all fifteen tutorials, claim their rewards, navigate the Quest Log, and check fifty optional trophy goals.
pages.summary_zh: 完成十五项教程并领取奖励，使用任务日志查进度，再按需查阅五十项奖杯目标。

pages.title: Game Systems:Tower Defense
pages.summary_en: Prepare your first defence, use the battle controls, and understand campaign clears, Infinite mode and banking rewards.
pages.summary_zh: 从第一场防御战开始，掌握部署与操作，并分清战役通关、无限模式、保存战果与返回游戏的规则。

pages.title: Game Systems:TD Army
pages.summary_en: Recruit and train heroes, compare personal and Army EXP, choose equipment, and understand automatic special abilities.
pages.summary_zh: 招募与训练英雄，区分个人经验和军队经验，选择装备，并查清自动特殊技能的作用与培养方式。

pages.title: Game Systems:TD Workshops
pages.title_en: Tower Defense Workshops and Permanent Upgrades
pages.summary_en: Find each workshop, compare turret and barrier research, plan grenade upgrades, and improve shared defence facilities.
pages.summary_zh: 找到各个工坊，比较炮塔和屏障研发，规划手榴弹升级，并查清要塞设施的强化入口与费用。

pages.title: Game Systems:TD Battle Reference
pages.summary_en: Check personal shooting, placement limits, enemy behavior, six campaign wave tables, Infinite growth and reward rules.
pages.summary_zh: 查阅个人射击、部署限制、敌人特点、六场战役逐波表，以及无限模式成长和奖励规则。

pages.summary_zh: 开放玫瑰与荆棘，推进办公室事件与员工训练。

pages.title: Character:Willow
pages.summary_en: Recruit the healer, improve training and collect ten medicine specimens.
pages.summary_zh: 招募治疗人员，升级训练并收集十种药用标本。

pages.title: Character:Marina
pages.summary_en: Fishing lessons, boat upgrades and the route to Sirena Isle.

pages.summary_zh: 解锁吟游诗人，推进歌曲、约会与多场所演奏进度。

pages.title: Character:Cid

pages.summary_en: Acquire all six maids, compare thirty-two equipment items, and understand EXP, slots, daily cleaning and business bonuses.

pages.title: Game Systems:Morrie
